import importlib.util, json
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('m', '/workspace/submission/main.py')
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)
tests = [
    (b'{"services": ["\xc3\xa9"], "rules": [], "queries": []}', 'ok'),          # valid 2-byte
    (b'{"services": ["\xc3"], "rules": [], "queries": []}', 'E_JSON'),          # truncated
    (b'{"services": ["\xf0\x9f\x98\x80"], "rules": [], "queries": []}', 'ok'),  # 4-byte emoji
    (b'{"services": ["\xf0\x9f\x98"], "rules": [], "queries": []}', 'E_JSON'),  # truncated 4-byte
    (b'{"services": ["\xed\xa0\x80"], "rules": [], "queries": []}', 'E_JSON'),  # CESU-8 surrogate
    (b'{"services": ["\xc0\x80"], "rules": [], "queries": []}', 'E_JSON'),      # overlong
    (b'\xef\xbb\xbf{"services": [], "rules": [], "queries": []}', 'E_JSON'),    # BOM
    (b'{"services": ["\xf5\x80\x80\x80"], "rules": [], "queries": []}', 'E_JSON'),  # > U+10FFFF
    (b'{"services": ["\xc2\x80"], "rules": [], "queries": []}', 'ok'),          # U+0080
    (b'{"services": ["\xe4\xb8\xad"], "rules": [], "queries": []}', 'ok'),      # CJK
]
for raw, want in tests:
    got = json.loads(m.process(raw))
    ok = (got.get('ok') is True) if want == 'ok' else (got.get('error') == want)
    print(('PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'), want, got)
# multibyte char split across two lines
data = b'{"services": ["\xe4\xb8', b'\xad"], "rules": [], "queries": []}'
for raw in data:
    print(json.loads(m.process(raw)))
